newsitem.title: USA: LTV Corp gets $29 mln Thompson-CSF judgement.
newsitem.headline: LTV Corp gets $29 mln Thompson-CSF judgement.

text.p: The LTV Corp said Monday it has received a $29.3 million from a judgment against Thomson-CSF SA related to Thomson's unsuccessful effort to secure U.S. Government approval for its proposed purchase of LTV's Aerospace and Defense Company in 1992. .
Under terms of an agreement between LTV and Thomson, failure to secure such approval resulted in Thomson having to pay LTV, a "reverse break-up fee," LTV said.
The company said that under its reorganization plan, it is required to contribute one-half of the proceeds to an aerospace creditor trust.
LTV said the proceeds would be reflected in its remaining balance sheet reserves for bankruptcy-related issues.

LTV manufactures value-added, flat-rolled steel for the automotive, appliance and electrical equipment markets; welded pipe, tubing and electrical conduit; and tin plated steel for the container industry.
